profile.headline: Software Engineer/Software Technical Lead
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 20+ years of experience building high-performance tools, systems, and engines for the AAA games industry. Two-time Electronic Arts engineer with deep expertise in game client development, large-scale ETL pipelines, and crossstudio tooling adopted worldwide. Proven technical lead with hands-on experience across the full stack -from low-level C/C++ systems and game engines (Unity, Unreal, Direct3D) to cloud-native backends (AWS, Docker, Elasticsearch) and modern frontends. Recognized for architecting solutions that improve developer productivity, reduce release overhead, and ship reliably at scale.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
• Own live update and patching support for the FC titles, ensuring stable and reliable delivery of game updates to a global player base. 
• Drive technical assessments, sprint planning, and end-to-end client-side feature implementation as part of the live development team for the FC franchise. 
• Diagnose and resolve critical client stability issues across all console platforms in the FC cycle, with specialized focus on the Nintendo Switch platform, directly reducing crash rates and improving platform health for millions of players. 
• Provide systems-level support and cross-functional collaboration to maintain live service continuity throughout the FC24–26 release cycle. 
• Contributed to feature development for Football Ultimate Team (FUT) and the Commerce team, delivering client-side work across both high-visibility areas of the FC titles.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · C# · Debugging · .NET Core · C · Game Development · SQL · Software Development · Software Engineering · Visual Studio · ActionScript · Perforce

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Sole architect and implementer of the company’s game launcher, delivering both the backend (Dotnet, AWS S3/storage services, Docker microservices) and the frontend (MAUI with Blazor Hybrid) from the ground up. 
• Designed and shipped a fully automated build pipeline that compiled, versioned, cached, and delta-patched builds to end users with zero developer intervention — eliminating manual release steps entirely. 
• Established the foundational DevOps infrastructure and tooling culture for an early-stage studio, enabling the team to ship updates continuously as development scaled.
positions.insights: Skills: Unity Pro · maui · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · .NET Core · Blazor · Linux · SQL · Docker Products · Perforce · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Visual Studio

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and developed Vision API, an internal web platform enabling QA and development teams to query hundreds of millions of rows of game telemetry and instantly surface correlated video footage of exact in-game moments (Docker microservices, Elasticsearch, Dotnet Core, RabbitMQ). 
• Built an industry-scale broker-based ETL system capable of ingesting and processing billions of telemetry events from live game clients; system was adopted as the de-facto telemetry standard across multiple EA studios globally. • Designed and shipped tools that are actively used across most of EA’s worldwide studios, contributing to developer productivity at an enterprise level. 
• Partnered with EA studios across North America and Europe to integrate tools into existing pipelines, providing technical guidance and hands-on implementation support. 
• Direct game credits: Madden NFL 17–23 (PS4/PS5/XB1/XBSX/PC), NBA Live (PS4/XB1), EA Sports PGA Tour (PS5/XBSX/PC). 
• Indirect contributions: Dragon Age: The Veilguard, Dead Space Remake, Skate, FIFA 22.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · C++ · HTML5 · JavaScript · RabbitMQ · .NET Core · Elasticsearch · MongoDB · TypeScript · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · SQL · Docker Products · Linux · Microsoft SQL Server · Kubernetes · Jenkins · Git · Perforce · Gitlabs · Angular · Visual Studio

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: • Implemented the backend physics and data model for an earthquake simulation within a web-based geospatial training application used for real-world emergency preparedness scenarios.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · HTML5 · SQL · C++ · Geographic Information Systems (GIS) · RabbitMQ · Visual Studio

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Shipped Sword Coast Legends and its Rage of Demons expansion across PC, Mac, Linux, XB1, and PS4 using the Unity Engine; contributed to core gameplay systems throughout the title. 
• Designed and implemented a multiplayer dialogue system end-to-end, including a custom in-editor authoring tool and the full runtime execution layer. 
• Built an automated multi-platform asset bundle builder handling scene and asset compilation across PC, Mac, Linux, and console targets.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Unity Pro · Linux · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Playstation · Xbox · Python (Programming Language) · Tortoise SVN

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer/Technical Lead
positions.description:
• Led a team of eight engineers on a U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs virtual world project built in Unity, personally responsible for the core client framework, avatar customization system, level loader, and asset-bundle management architecture. 
• Engineered a C++ expert-system rules engine with Lex/Yacc parsing and CLIPS integration, exposing dual interfaces to .NET and Java for cross-platform use. 
• Shipped Android and iOS mobile experiences, VBS2 integrations, and multiple internal pipeline tools that measurably improved team throughput.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · C# · Unity Pro · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · SQL · WinForms · MFC · Team Leadership · Technical Leadership · Linux · Git · Tortoise SVN · Yacc · Lex · Visual Studio

positions.title: Software Engineer/Build Engineer
positions.description: • Gameplay and build engineer on Madden NFL / NCAA Football 2012 (Xbox 360, PS3); managed the complex code-line merge and integration process between both shared titles.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Perforce · Visual Studio

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a suite of artist-facing pipeline tools in MaxScript, C#, and C++ that automated texture optimization, asset compilation, and database-driven level exports — directly reducing build times and artist iteration cycles. 
• Authored core gameplay systems and 10+ mini games shipped across Nintendo DS titles including Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Black Ops, GoldenEye, Star Wars: The Force Unleashed, Marvel Ultimate Alliance 2, and Battlefront: Elite Squadron.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Maxscript · Nintendo DS · C# · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Visual SourceSafe (VSS)

positions.title: Software Engineer/Props and Level Modeler
positions.description: • Programmed interactive virtual training simulations for the construction, drilling, and mining industries, combining real-time 3D rendering with instructional scenario logic.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Autodesk Maya · Virtools

positions.description: • Drafting floor plans for various commercial and residential projects using CAD software.

projects.title: Veteran Affairs - Virtual Medical Center
projects.description: The Veteran Affairs Virtual Medical Center (VA-VMC) is a virtual world where patients and providers from around the world can connect and share information. It also provides a learning center for patients, providers, and VA staff.
